title: Glucose-ML: A collection of longitudinal diabetes datasets for development of robust AI solutions
abstract: arXiv:2507.14077v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms are a critical part of state-of-the-art digital health technology for diabetes management. Yet, access to large high-quality datasets is creating barriers that impede development of robust AI solutions. To accelerate development of transparent, reproducible, and robust AI solutions, we present Glucose-ML, a collection of 10 publicly available diabetes datasets, released within the last 7 years (i.e., 2018 - 2025). The Glucose-ML collection comprises over 300,000 days of continuous glucose monitor (CGM) data with a total of 38 million glucose samples collected from 2500+ people across 4 countries. Participants include persons living with type 1 diabetes, type 2 diabetes, prediabetes, and no diabetes. translated_title: Glucose-ML：用于开发稳健AI解决方案的纵向糖尿病数据集集合
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）算法是糖尿病管理领域最先进数字健康技术的关键组成部分。然而，获取大规模高质量数据集存在障碍，阻碍了稳健AI解决方案的开发。为了加速开发透明、可复现且稳健的AI解决方案，我们推出了Glucose-ML，这是一个包含10个公开可用糖尿病数据集的集合，这些数据集均在过去7年内（即2018年至2025年）发布。Glucose-ML数据集集合包含超过30万天的连续血糖监测（CGM）数据，共计3800万个血糖样本，数据来自4个国家的2500多名参与者。参与者包括1型糖尿病患者、2型糖尿病患者、糖尿病前期人群以及非糖尿病人群。为了帮助研究人员和创新者使用这一丰富的糖尿病数据集资源，我们提供了比较分析，以指导算法开发者进行数据选择。此外，……
tldr: 该论文推出Glucose-ML数据集集合，汇集10个公开可用的糖尿病数据集，包含来自4个国家2500多人的30万天CGM数据和3800万个血糖样本，并通过比较分析指导算法开发者进行数据选择，以加速开发透明、可复现且稳健的糖尿病管理AI解决方案。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Glucose-ML, a collection of 10 publicly available diabetes datasets comprising over 300,000 days of CGM data and 38 million glucose samples from 2500+ participants across 4 countries, along with a comparative analysis to guide algorithm developers in data selection for building robust AI solutions for diabetes management.
